122003.desc:

122003.notes:
Using Terrasplit requires Feixiao to accumulate a minimum of six "Flying Aureus" points, rather than requiring energy. These points are accumulated for every two attacks made by Feixiao's allies, including follow-up attacks (or one follow-up attack with the second Eidolon, Moonward I Wish). The ultimate does not count towards the point accumulation.
If Feixiao's Ultimate is activated through other effects such as Brain in a Vat in Simulated Universe and Ruinous Embers in Apocalyptic Shadow, her Flying Aureus points will increase to 12, allowing her to use two Ultimates in a row.
After the Ultimate is cast and before launching the finishing hit, Feixiao can perform either Boltsunder Blitz or Waraxe Skyward on the enemy for a total of six times; Boltsunder Blitz is more effective against Weakness Broken enemies and Waraxe Skyward more effective against unbroken enemies. The game will highlight which one of the two is more effective against the attacked target.
During this step, the Action Order and Character Details menu button are hidden and therefore prevents the player from viewing details of units in the battlefield.
During this step, heads-up display of Feixiao's allies and the Special Ability icon (such as Path Resonances and abilities exclusive to certain boss fights) are hidden, preventing the player from queuing ally Ultimates and Special Abilities.
Feixiao's second Bonus Ability, Formshift, causes the damage from this Ultimate to be considered as follow-up DMG. As the ability also increases follow-up Crit DMG by 36%, it further increases the damage dealt by this Ultimate.
Feixiao's first Eidolon, Skyward I Quell, using either Boltsunder Blitz or Waraxe Skyward will increase the Ultimate DMG inflicted by 10% of the original DMG, stacking up to 5 times and is used at the end of this Ultimate.
Feixiao's sixth Eidolon, Homeward I Near, causes the Ultimate DMG to apply a 20% All-Type RES PEN.

"Flying Aureus" stacks and half-stacks are displayed below her portrait.
Even after attaining twelve stacks of "Flying Aureus," up to two additional half-stacks can be retained, effectively allowing Feixiao to have an extra "Flying Aureus" stack.
If Feixiao receives an effect that activates her Ultimate, such as Erudition's Path Trait "Brain in a Vat," her "Flying Aureus" stacks will be set to 12.

Because the Eidolon increases the All-Type RES Pen of Ultimate DMG by 20% (of which the Talent is now considered as), the Talent's DMG is significantly increased.

122103.name: Earthbind, Etherbreak
122103.desc:
Consumes #8[i] Energy. Yunli gains Parry and Taunts all enemies, lasting until the end of the next ally's or enemy's turn. Increases the CRIT DMG dealt by Yunli's next Counter by #2[i]%. When triggering the Counter effect from Talent, launches the Counter "Intuit: Cull" instead and removes the Parry effect. If no Counter is triggered while Parry is active, Yunli will immediately launch the Counter "Intuit: Slash" on a random enemy target.

"Intuit: Slash": Deals Physical DMG equal to #1[i]% of Yunli's ATK to the target, and deals Physical DMG equal to #6[i]% of Yunli's ATK to adjacent targets.
"Intuit: Cull": Deals Physical DMG equal to #1[i]% of Yunli's ATK to the target, and deals Physical DMG equal to #6[i]% of Yunli's ATK to adjacent targets. Then, additionally deals #4[i] instances of DMG, each dealing Physical DMG equal to #7[i]% of Yunli's ATK to a random single enemy.

When Yunli deals DMG via this ability, it's considered as dealing Ultimate DMG.
122103.notes:
Yunli has 240 Max Energy, allowing for two instances of the Ultimate to be activated.
Effects that activate an ally unit's Ultimate, such as Erudition's Path Trait "Brain in a Vat," sets Yunli's Energy to this maximum amount (240).
DMG of "Intuit: Cull" is dealt in 8 hits. The DMG distribution across hits is 12% + 12% + 12% + 12% + 12% + 12% + 12% + 16%.
DMG dealt by "Intuit: Slash" and "Intuit: Cull" is considered both Ultimate DMG and Follow-Up Attack DMG.
However, triggering "Intuit: Slash" or "Intuit: Cull" is not considered using an Ultimate, and using the Ultimate does not count as using an attack. Therefore, effects that require using an Ultimate to attack cannot be triggered.
For the 2-piece effect of Relic Set Inert Salsotto, the DMG Boost effect is only calculated once even though the DMG counts as both Ultimate DMG and Follow-Up Attack DMG.
Turns taken by summons will not prompt Yunli to unleash an Intuit attack.
Yunli's Technique, Posterior Precedence, causes her to use Intuit: Cull upon attacking an enemy or being attacked by one.
Yunli's first Bonus Ability, Fiery Wheel, causes Yunli to use "Intuit: Cull" the next time she would use "Intuit: Slash" after triggering said counter type. This is indicated with an active circle around her the sword on her character icon.
Yunli's second Bonus Ability, Demon Quell, allows Yunli to resist Crowd Control debuffs and reduces DMG taken by 20% while Parry is active.
Yunli's first Eidolon, Weathered Blade Does Not Sully increases the DMG dealt by either form of Intuit by 20%, and deals an additional three hits with "Intuit: Cull".
Yunli's second Eidolon, First Luster Breaks Dawn, further increases the DMG dealt by either form of Intuit by 20%, as both are considered counters.

130302.notes: Ruan Mei's Technique, Silken Serenade, will trigger this Skill automatically upon entering battle without consuming a Skill Point and also generates energy for her.

130303.name: Petals to Stream, Repose in Dream
130303.desc:
Ruan Mei deploys a Zone that lasts for #2[i] turns. The Zone's duration decreases by 1 at the start of her turn.
While inside the Zone, all allies' All-Type RES PEN increases by #1[f1]% and their attacks apply Thanatoplum Rebloom to the enemies hit.
When these enemies attempt to recover from Weakness Break, Thanatoplum Rebloom is triggered, extending the duration of their Weakness Break, delaying their action by an amount equal to #3[i]% of Ruan Mei's Break Effect plus #4[i]%, and dealing Break DMG equal to #5[i]% of Ruan Mei's Ice Break DMG.
Enemy targets cannot have Thanatoplum Rebloom re-applied to them until they recover from Weakness Break.
130303.notes:
Thanatoplum Rebloom will immediately cause Weakness Break when the enemy attempts to recover while affected by the debuff, regardless of their weaknesses. This works similarly to the Frozen status effect in applying bleeds and using up the enemy's turn. If both of these are applied on one enemy, Frozen will take place first, then Thanatoplum Rebloom on the enemy's second action.
Some specific scenarios may cause enemies to exit Weakness Break and perform an action even when affected by Thanatoplum, such as The Past, Present, and Eternal Show when using their Dance for Synchrony or "Harmonious Choir" The Great Septimus' Tempestoso on its Echo of Faded Dreams. In these cases, the Break DMG is applied after the attack ends.
Ruan Mei's first Eidolon, Neuronic Embroidery, causes ally units' attacks to ignore 20% of the enemy's DEF when the field is active.
Ruan Mei's sixth Eidolon, Sash Cascade, increases the field's duration to 3 turns, and increases the Break DMG multiplier by 200%.

When breaking Weakness, triggers Weakness Break Effect corresponding to the attacker's Type. For every Blessing in possession (up to a max of #4[i] Blessings will be taken into account), additionally increases the Toughness Reduction of this attack by #2[i]%. After breaking an enemy target's Weakness, additionally deals to the enemy target Break DMG equal to #3[i]% of Ruan Mei's Ice Break DMG.

However, the first manual usage of her Skill will not consume a Skill Point.
This Technique's Break DMG is multiplied by the number of Blessings in possession (up to a max of 20 Blessings will be taken into account).
In Simulated Universe: Unknowable Domain, every star of a Component counts as 1 Blessing in possession when calculating the Toughness Reduction increase and the Break DMG multiplier.

Deals Wind DMG equal to #1[i]% of Anaxa's ATK to one designated enemy and additionally deals #2[i] instance(s) of DMG. Each instance of DMG deals Wind DMG equal to #1[i]% of Anaxa's ATK to one random enemy, prioritizing Bouncing to enemy targets that have not been hit by this instance of Skill.
When used, for each attackable enemy on the field, this Skill has its DMG dealt increased by #3[i]%.
140502.notes:
Anaxa's first Eidolon, Magician, Isolated by Stars, recovers 1 Skill Point after using Skill for the first time. When using Skill to hit enemy targets, decreases the targets' DEF by 16%, lasting for 2 turns.
Anaxa's fourth Eidolon, Blaze, Plunged to Canyon, increases ATK by 30% when using Skill, lasting for 2 turns and stacking up to 2 times.
Cyrene's Memosprite Skill, Ode to Reason, increases this ability's instances of DMG by 3, lasting for 1 turn.

140503.name: Sprouting Life Sculpts Earth
140503.desc:
Inflicts the "Sublimation" state on all enemies, then deals Wind DMG equal to #1[i]% of Anaxa's ATK to all enemies.
In the "Sublimation" state, the targets will be simultaneously inflicted with Physical, Fire, Ice, Lightning, Wind, Quantum, and Imaginary Weaknesses, lasting until the start of the targets' turn. If the targets do not have Control RES, they are unable to take action in the "Sublimation" state.

140504.name: Tetrad Wisdom Reigns Thrice
140504.desc:
Each time Anaxa lands 1 hit on enemy targets, inflicts 1 Weakness of a random Type to the targets, lasting for #2[i] turn(s), with priority to the Weakness Type that the target doesn't already possess.
While Anaxa is on the field, inflicts the "Qualitative Disclosure" state on enemy targets that have at least #3[i] different Types of Weaknesses. Anaxa deals #1[i]% increased DMG to targets afflicted with the "Qualitative Disclosure" state. In addition, after using Basic ATK or Skill on them, unleashes 1 additional instance of Skill on the targets. This additional Skill does not consume any Skill Points and cannot trigger this effect again. If the target has been defeated before the additional Skill is used, it will be cast on one random enemy instead.
140504.notes:
Anaxa's additional instance of Skill is an automatic Extra Turn, as shown by the four-pointed star icon on the left of this turn in the Action Order.
This Extra Turn is generated the moment Anaxa casts his regular Basic ATK Basic ATK or Skill Skill.
Ultimates cast during this Extra Turn are queued behind to it, after the last item in the queue.
Therefore, it is not possible to insert an Ultimate between Anaxa's regular Basic ATK or Skill and the Extra Turn.
Anaxa's first Bonus Ability, Roaming Signifier, regenerates 30 Energy if there are no enemy targets in the "Qualitative Disclosure" state at the start of the turn.
Anaxa's second Eidolon, Soul, True to History, triggers 1 instance of the Talent's Weakness Implant effect on enemy targets when they enter the battlefield and reduces their All-Type RES by 20%.

140506.name: Attack
140506.desc: Attacks an enemy, and after entering combat, reduces their Toughness of the corresponding Type.

140507.name: Prism of the Pupil
140507.desc: After using Technique, inflicts the Terrified state on enemies in a set area. Terrified enemies will flee in a direction away from Anaxa for #1[i] second(s). When allies enter combat via actively attacking a Terrified enemy, it will always be considered as entering battle via attacking a Weakness. After entering battle, Anaxa applies 1 Weakness of the attacker's Type to every enemy target, lasting for #2[i] turn(s).

1.name: Magician, Isolated by Stars
1.desc: After using Skill for the first time, recovers 1 Skill Point(s). When using Skill to hit enemy targets, decreases the targets' DEF by 16%, lasting for 2 turn(s).

2.name: Soul, True to History
2.desc: When enemy targets enter the battlefield, triggers 1 instance of the Talent's Weakness Implant effect, and reduces their All-Type RES by 20%.

3.name: Pupil, Etched into Cosmos
3.desc:
Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.

4.name: Blaze, Plunged to Canyon
4.desc: When using Skill, increases ATK by 30%, lasting for 2 turn(s). This effect can stack up to 2 time(s).

5.name: Embryo, Set Beyond Vortex
5.desc:
Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.

6.name: Everything Is in Everything
6.desc: The DMG dealt by Anaxa is 130% of the original DMG. The 2 effects in the Trace "Imperative Hiatus" will be triggered directly and will no longer depend on the number of "Erudition" characters in the team.

bonus_abilities.name: Roaming Signifier
bonus_abilities.desc:
When using Basic ATK, additionally regenerates 10 Energy.
At the start of the turn, if there are no enemy targets in the "Qualitative Disclosure" state, immediately regenerates 30 Energy.

bonus_abilities.name: Imperative Hiatus
bonus_abilities.desc:
Based on the number of "Erudition" characters in the team, one of the following effects will be triggered in the current battle:
1 character: Increases Anaxa's CRIT DMG by 140%.
At least 2 characters: Increases DMG dealt by all allies by 50%.

bonus_abilities.name: Qualitative Shift
bonus_abilities.desc: For every 1 different Weakness Type an enemy target has, the DMG that Anaxa deals to that target ignores 4% of their DEF. Up to a max of 7 Weakness Types can be taken into account for this effect.

name: Cipher

140601.name: Oops, a Missed Catch
140601.desc: Deals Quantum DMG equal to #1[i]% of Cipher's ATK to one designated enemy.

140602.name: Hey, Jackpot for the Taking
140602.desc: Has a #6[i]% base chance to Weaken one designated enemy and its adjacent targets (decreasing their DMG dealt by #3[i]%) and increases Cipher's ATK by #5[i]%, lasting for #4[i] turn(s). Moreover, deals Quantum DMG equal to #1[i]% of Cipher's ATK to one designated enemy, and Quantum DMG equal to #2[i]% of Cipher's ATK to the adjacent targets.
140602.notes: This ability's DMG is dealt in 6 hits. The DMG distribution across hits is 10% + 10% + 10% + 10% + 10% + 50%.

140603.name: Yours Truly, <unbreak>Kitty Phantom Thief!</unbreak>
140603.desc: Deals Quantum DMG equal to #1[i]% of Cipher's ATK to one designated enemy. Then, deals True DMG equal to #2[i]% of the current tally kept by Talent to the one designated enemy. Moreover, deals Quantum DMG equal to #4[i]% of Cipher's ATK alongside True DMG equal to #3[i]% of the current tally kept by Talent to the one designated enemy and its adjacent targets. And this True DMG is distributed evenly among all targets of this ability.
140603.notes:
The first instance of Quantum DMG deals 10 Toughness Reduction to the designated enemy.
The first True DMG to the designated enemy (equal to 25% of the currently recorded Talent value) deals 5 instances of DMG. The DMG distribution across instances is 20% + 20% + 20% + 20% + 20%.
The second instance of Quantum DMG deals 20 Toughness Reduction to the designated enemy and its adjacent targets.
The second True DMG to the designated enemy and its adjacent targets (equal to 75% of the currently recorded Talent value) deals 1 instance of DMG.

140604.name: The Hospitable Dolosian
140604.desc:
When there are no enemy targets in the "Patron" state on the battlefield, Cipher immediately causes one enemy target with the highest Max HP on the battlefield to become the "Patron." When using Skill and Ultimate, the primary target becomes the "Patron." The "Patron" state only takes effect on the most recent target.
After the "Patron" gets attacked by other ally targets, Cipher immediately launches Follow-Up ATK against the "Patron," dealing Quantum DMG equal to #1[i]% of Cipher's ATK. This effect can trigger up to #3[i] time(s) per turn, and this trigger count resets at the start of Cipher's turn.
Cipher will tally #2[i]% of the non-True DMG dealt by ally targets to the "Patron." Overflow DMG will not be tallied. After using Ultimate, clears this tally.
140604.notes:
This ability's DMG is dealt in 4 hits. The DMG distribution across hits is 20% + 10% + 10% + 60%.
The coin counter under Cipher's avatar is measured in thousands, i.e. every 1 counter = 1,000 recorded value.
The max amount of counter that can be displayed is 99,999 which does not cap the recorded value in gameplay.
Cipher's first Bonus Ability, Empyrean Strides, increases recorded value by 50%/100% when Cipher's SPD is greater or equal to 140/170.
Cipher's second Bonus Ability, 300 Rogues, allows her to record 8% of the non-True DMG ally targets dealt to the enemy targets aside from the "Patron."
Cipher's third Bonus Ability, Sleight of Sky, increases the CRIT DMG dealt by the Talent's Follow-up ATK by 100%.
Cipher's first Eidolon, Read the Room, Seek the Glee, makes Cipher's recorded DMG 150% of the original recorded DMG value. When using a Follow-up ATK caused by her Talent, increases Cipher's ATK by 80% for 2 turns.
Cipher's fourth Eidolon, The Jig Is Up, Quick to Flee, deals Quantum Additional DMG equal to 50% of Cipher's ATK to the "Patron" after it is attacked by an ally target.
Cipher's sixth Eidolon, The Thief's Game, Unsung and Free, increases DMG dealt by Follow-up ATKs caused by Cipher's Talent by 350%. Records an additional 16% of non-Overflow DMG dealt by this ATK. After resetting the record upon using her Ultimate Yours Truly, Kitty Phantom Thief!, returns 20% of the reset record.

140606.name: Attack
140606.desc: Attacks an enemy, and after entering combat, reduces their Toughness of the corresponding Type.

140607.name: Puss in Boots
140607.desc:
Gains "Zagreus's Blessing" that lasts for #1[i] second(s). During this time, Cipher will be undetectable by enemies and her movement speed increases by 50%. When approaching an enemy in the overworld/Simulated Universe/Divergent Universe, can immediately gain a random Consumable. Consumables can be gained this way for up to #4[i] time(s) in each Earth day.
When entering battle with "Zagreus's Blessing" active, deals Quantum DMG equal to #3[i]% of Cipher's ATK to all enemies. And the tallied amount Cipher gains from this instance of DMG increases by #2[i]%.
140607.notes: After using this Technique, Cipher will automatically enter the Sprint mode.

1.name: Read the Room, Seek the Glee
1.desc: Cipher's tally of DMG is 150% of its original value. When using the Talent's Follow-Up ATK, increases Cipher's ATK by 80%, lasting for 2 turn(s).

2.name: In the Fray, Nab On a Spree
2.desc: When Cipher hits an enemy target, there is a 120% base chance to increase the DMG it receives by 30%, lasting for 2 turn(s).

3.name: From Thin Air, Hard to Foresee
3.desc:
Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.

4.name: The Jig Is Up, Quick to Flee
4.desc: After the "Patron" gets attacked by an ally target, Cipher deals Quantum Additional DMG to it equal to 50% of Cipher's ATK.

5.name: Safe in Numbers, Light as a Bee
5.desc:
Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.

6.name: The Thief's Game, Unsung and Free
6.desc: The DMG dealt by Follow-Up ATK from Cipher's Talent increases by 350%. During the tally, an additional 16% of non-Overflow DMG dealt by this attack is tallied. After the tally is cleared by using Ultimate, 20% of the cleared tally is returned.

bonus_abilities.name: Empyrean Strides
bonus_abilities.desc: When Cipher's SPD is higher than or equal to 140/170, CRIT Rate increases by 25%/50%, and the gained tally increases by 50%/100%.

bonus_abilities.name: <unbreak>300</unbreak> Rogues
bonus_abilities.desc: Cipher can tally 8% of the non-True DMG dealt by ally targets to the enemy targets other than the "Patron." Overflow DMG is not tallied.

bonus_abilities.name: Sleight of Sky
bonus_abilities.desc: Increases the CRIT DMG dealt by the Talent's Follow-Up ATK by 100%. When Cipher is on the battlefield, DMG received by all enemy targets increases by 40%.

lightcones: Resolution Shines As Pearls of Sweat

140701.name: Lament, Nethersea's Ripple
140701.desc: Deals Quantum DMG equal to #1[i]% of Castorice's Max HP to one designated enemy.
140701.notes: This ability's DMG is dealt in 2 hits. The DMG distribution across hits is 20% + 80%.

140702.name: Silence, Wraithfly's Caress
140702.desc:
Consumes #1[i]% of all allies' current HP. Deals Quantum DMG equal to #2[i]% of Castorice's Max HP to one designated enemy and Quantum DMG equal to #3[i]% of Castorice's Max HP to adjacent targets.
If the current HP is insufficient, reduces the current HP down to 1.
If Netherwing is on the battlefield, the Skill becomes "Boneclaw, Doomdrake's Embrace" instead.
140702.notes: This ability does not consume Skill Points.

140703.name: Doomshriek, Dawn's Chime
140703.desc:
Summons the memosprite Netherwing and advances its action by 100%. At the same time, deploys the Territory "Lost Netherland," which decreases all enemies' All-Type RES by #4[i]%. If Castorice has the DMG Boost effect from her Talent, then this effect spreads to Netherwing. Netherwing has an initial SPD of #1[i] and a set Max HP equal to #3[i]% of max "Newbud."
After Netherwing experiences #2[i] turns or when its HP is 0, it disappears and dispels the Territory "Lost Netherland."

140704.name: Desolation Across Palms
140704.desc:
The maximum limit of "Newbud" is related to the levels of all characters on the battlefield. For every 1 point of HP lost by all allies, Castorice gains 1 point of "Newbud." When "Newbud" reaches its maximum limit, can activate the Ultimate. When allies lose HP, Castorice's and Netherwing's DMG dealt increases by #2[i]%. This effect can stack up to #3[i] time(s), lasting for #4[i] turn(s).
When Netherwing is on the field, "Newbud" cannot be gained through Talent, and every 1 point of HP lost by all allies (except Netherwing) will be converted to an equal amount of HP for Netherwing.

140706.name: Attack
140706.desc: Attacks an enemy, and after entering combat, reduces their Toughness of the corresponding Type.

140707.name: Wail, Death's Herald
140707.desc:
After using Technique, enters the "Netherveil" state that lasts for #3[i] seconds. While "Netherveil" is active, enemies are unable to actively approach Castorice.
During "Netherveil," active attacks will cause all enemies within range to enter combat. At the same time, summons the memosprite Netherwing, advances its action by 100%, and deploys the Territory "Lost Netherland." Netherwing has its current HP equal to #2[i]% of max "Newbud." After entering battle, consumes #1[i]% of the current HP of all allies (except Netherwing).
If Netherwing is not summoned after entering battle, Castorice gains "Newbud" by an amount equal to #4[i]% of max "Newbud."
140707.notes: Triggering combat with this Technique does not reduce Toughness.

140709.name: Boneclaw, Doomdrake's Embrace
140709.desc:
Consumes #1[i]% of the current HP of all allies (except Netherwing). Castorice and Netherwing launch Joint ATK on the targets, dealing Quantum DMG equal to #2[f1]% and #3[f1]% of Castorice's Max HP to all enemies.
If the current HP is insufficient, reduces the current HP down to 1.
140709.notes:
This ability does not consume Skill Points.
During this ability's Joint ATK, Castorice attacks first, followed by Netherwing's attack.
Castorice's attack deals 10 Toughness Reduction. Castorice's DMG is dealt in 1 hit.
Netherwing's attack deals 10 Toughness Reduction. Netherwing's DMG is dealt in 1 hit.
Castorice's second Eidolon, Crown on Wings of Bloom, allows her to gain 30% of maximum "Newbud" points in the next usage of "Boneclaw, Doomdrake's Embrace" after summoning Netherwing.

1.name: Snowbound Maiden, Memory to Tomb
1.desc: When the enemy target's current HP is 80%/50% of Max HP or lower, the DMG dealt to it by "Boneclaw, Doomdrake's Embrace," "Claw Splits the Veil," "Breath Scorches the Shadow," and "Wings Sweep the Ruins" is 120%/140% of the original DMG respectively.

2.name: Crown on Wings of Bloom
2.desc: After summoning the memosprite Netherwing, Castorice gains 2 stack(s) of "Ardent Will." "Ardent Will" can stack up to 2 time(s) and can be used to offset the HP cost of Netherwing's Memosprite Skill, "Breath Scorches the Shadow" and advance Castorice's action by 100%. When using the next Enhanced Skill, Castorice gains "Newbud" by an amount equal to 30% of max "Newbud."

3.name: Pious Pilgrim, Dance in Doom
3.desc:
Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.
Memosprite Talent Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.

4.name: Rest in Songs of Gloom
4.desc: While Castorice is on the field, all allies' HP restored when receiving healing increases by 20%.

5.name: Pristine Pages, Prophecy as Plume
5.desc:
Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Memosprite Skill Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.

6.name: Await for Years to Loom
6.desc: When Castorice or Netherwing deals DMG, increases Quantum RES PEN by 20%. During Netherwing's attacks, can reduce enemy Toughness regardless of Weakness Types. When breaking Weaknesses, triggers the Quantum Weakness Break effect. And the number of Bounces for Netherwing's Talent "Wings Sweep the Ruins" additionally increases by 3.

1140701.name: Claw Splits the Veil
1140701.desc: Deals Quantum DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[f1]%</unbreak></color> of Castorice's Max HP to all enemies.
1140701.simple_desc: Deals minor Quantum DMG to all enemies.

1140702.name: Breath Scorches the Shadow
1140702.desc: Launching "Breath Scorches the Shadow" will consume <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> of Netherwing's Max HP to deal Quantum DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[f1]%</unbreak></color> of Castorice's Max HP to all enemies.\nIn one attack, "Breath Scorches the Shadow" can be launched repeatedly, with the DMG multiplier increased progressively to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[f1]%</unbreak></color> / <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#4[f1]%</unbreak></color>. After reaching <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#4[f1]%</unbreak></color>, it will not increase further. The DMG Multiplier Boost effect will not decrease before Netherwing disappears.\nWhen Netherwing's current HP is equal to or less than <unbreak>#5[i]%</unbreak> of its Max HP, launching this ability will actively reduce HP down to 1, and then trigger the ability effect equal to that of the Talent "Wings Sweep the Ruins."
1140702.simple_desc: Consumes this unit's HP to deal Quantum DMG to all enemies, and this turn will not conclude. When using this ability repeatedly, the ability can be enhanced up to 3 times. When HP is <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#5[i]%</unbreak></color> or lower, using this ability will actively trigger the ability effect of Memosprite Talent "Wings Sweep the Ruins."
1140702.notes:
This ability's DMG is dealt in 10 hits. The DMG distribution across hits is 10% × 10.
Breath Scorches the Shadow can be used consecutively by holding the button on screen (E on PC, on Xbox, and on PlayStation).
Netherwing's turn will not end until "Claw Splits the Veil" is used, "Wings Sweep the Ruins" is triggered, or if all enemies present on the field are killed by this Skill.
When Netherwing's current HP is equal to or less than 25% of its Max HP, it will enter the "Back to the Black" state.
In the third turn of Netherwing after it's summoned, it can only launch "Breath Scorches the Shadow" repeatedly until "Wings Sweep the Ruins" is triggered. This is forced even if all enemies present have no health left.
"Breath Scorches the Shadow" does not count as an attack for effects such as "War Armor" on Titankin enemies.
If the first breath has not been launched, casting an Ultimate during "Breath Scorches the Shadow" will interrupt this Memosprite Skill and the Ultimate will be performed.
If the first breath has been launched, casting Ultimates during "Breath Scorches the Shadow" will add them to the end of the Ultimate/Extra Turn queue, delaying them.
Castorice's second Bonus Ability, Inverted Torch, increases Netherwing's SPD by 100% for 1 turn when "Breath Scorches the Shadow" deals fatal damage to all enemies on the field or brings them to a point where they cannot lose more HP.
Castorice's third Bonus Ability, Where The West Wind Dwells, increases Netherwing's DMG dealt by 30% each time it uses "Breath Scorches the Shadow," stacking up to 6 times and lasting until the end of this turn.
Castorice's second Eidolon, Crown on Wings of Bloom, grants her 2 stacks of "Ardent Will" after summoning Netherwing, which can be used to offset Netherwing's HP consumption when using "Breath Scorches the Shadow."

1140703.name: Mooncocoon Shrouds the Form
1140703.desc: When Netherwing is on the field, it acts as <u>backup</u> for allies. When allies take DMG or consume HP, their current HP can be reduced down to a minimum of 1, after which Netherwing will bear the HP loss. But Netherwing consumes HP equal to <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> of the original value. This lasts until Netherwing disappears.
1140703.simple_desc: When Netherwing is on the field, it acts as <u>backup</u> for allies. Allies' current HP can be reduced down to a minimum of 1, after which Netherwing will bear the DMG received or the HP consumed.

10000021.name: Backup
10000021.desc: Enemies cannot actively target backup units. Allies' Blast-type abilities cannot Blast to backup units.

1140705.name: Roar Rumbles the Realm
1140705.desc: When Netherwing is summoned, increases DMG dealt by all allies by <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak>, lasting for <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> turn(s).
1140705.simple_desc: When summoned, increases the DMG dealt by all allies.

1140706.name: Wings Sweep the Ruins
1140706.desc: When Netherwing disappears, deals <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> instance(s) of DMG, with each instance dealing Quantum DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[f1]%</unbreak></color> of Castorice's Max HP to one random enemy. At the same time, restores HP by an amount equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak></color> of Castorice's Max HP plus <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#4[i]</unbreak></color> for all allies.
1140706.simple_desc: Upon disappearing, deals minor Quantum DMG to one enemy that Bounces a total of <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak></color> time(s). At the same time, restores HP for all allies.
1140706.notes: Castorice's sixth Eidolon, Await for Years to Loom, additionally increases the Bounce count for "Wings Sweep the Ruins" by 3 times.

1140712.desc: Consumes all HP and deals <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> instance(s) of DMG, with each instance dealing Quantum DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[f1]%</unbreak></color> of Castorice's Max HP to one random enemy. When Netherwing uses "Breath Scorches the Shadow" and deals fatal damage to all enemies on the field or brings them to a point where their HP cannot be reduced further, Netherwing's SPD increases by 100%, lasting for 1 turn.

bonus_abilities.desc: Each time Netherwing uses "Breath Scorches the Shadow," the DMG dealt increases by 30%. This effect stacks up to 6 time(s) and lasts until the end of this turn.

name: Phainon

140801.desc: Deals Physical DMG equal to #1[i]% of Phainon's ATK to one designated enemy.

140802.desc: Gains #3[i] point(s) of "Coreflame," dealing Physical DMG equal to #1[i]% of Phainon's ATK to one designated enemy and Physical DMG equal to #2[i]% of Phainon's ATK to adjacent targets.

140803.name: He Who Bears the World Must Burn
140803.desc:
Transforms into Khaslana. During the transformation, deploys the Territory "Ruinous Irontomb." Within the Territory, other teammates depart and cannot take action, and all enemies have Physical Weaknesses.
Khaslana does not enter his own turn, but has #4[i] Khaslana's extra turn(s), with a SPD set at #3[i]% of Khaslana's base SPD. When the last of Khaslana's extra turns starts, immediately launches a final hit and deals Physical Ultimate DMG equal to #1[i]% of Khaslana's ATK that is distributed evenly across all enemies.

As long as Phainon is Khaslana:
His active abilities are Creation: Bloodthorn Ferry, Calamity: Soulscorch Edict, and Foundation: Stardeath Verdict.

He cannot use an Ultimate again until he transforms back into Phainon.

140804.name: Pyric Corpus
140804.desc:
Phainon's Talent. When "Coreflame" reaches #4[i] point(s), can activate Ultimate. Even after reaching the limit, can still hold up to #3[i] overflow point(s). When the transformation ends, gains "Coreflame" based on the number of overflow points.
When Phainon is targeted by an ability from any other target, gains 1 "Coreflame" point. And if the ability is cast by one of Phainon's teammates, can also increase Phainon's CRIT DMG by #1[i]% for #2[i] turn(s).

140805.name: Fate: Divine Vessel
140805.desc:
Khaslana's Talent. Upon transformation, gains #1[i] point(s) of "Scourge". If this happens during an ally target's turn, then the duration of all buffs on that target is extended by 1 turn and the current turn ends.
Khaslana is immune to Crowd Control debuffs, has 1 Enhanced Basic ATK and 2 Enhanced Skills, but cannot use Ultimate. During the transformation, increases ATK by #4[i]% and Max HP by #5[i]%. After using an attack, restores HP equal to #7[i]% of his Max HP. When Khaslana takes a killing blow, he will not get knocked down. Instead, he will restore HP equal to #2[i]% of Max HP and immediately launch a final hit. For every 1 remaining Khaslana's extra turn, the final hit's DMG multiplier decreases by #3[f1]% of its original multiplier value.
When the transformation ends, increases all allies' SPD by #6[i]% for 1 turn.

140806.name: Attack
140806.desc: Attacks an enemy, and after entering combat, reduces their Toughness of the corresponding Type.

140807.name: Beginning of the End
140807.desc:
While Phainon is in the team, increases Max Technique Points by 3.
When actively using this Technique, consumes 2 Technique Points and immediately attacks all enemies within a certain range. After entering combat, regenerates #3[i] Energy for allies and gains #2[i] "Scourge" and #4[i] Skill Point(s). Deals Physical DMG equal to #1[i]% of Phainon's ATK to all enemies at the start of each wave.

140808.desc: Gains #3[i] point(s) of "Scourge", dealing Physical DMG equal to #1[i]% of Khaslana's ATK to one designated enemy and Physical DMG equal to #2[i]% of Khaslana's ATK to adjacent targets.

This ability does not recover Skill Points.
This ability's DMG is dealt in 2 hits. The DMG distribution across hits is 30% + 70%.

140809.name: Calamity: Soulscorch Edict
140809.desc:
Gains "Scourge" by an amount equal to the number of enemies and 1 stack of "Soulscorch," then causes all enemies to immediately take action.
While in the "Soulscorch" state, Khaslana takes #2[i]% reduced DMG. After an enemy target attacks or takes action, gains 1 more stack of "Soulscorch." After said enemy targets finish their actions, immediately launches Counter, deals Physical DMG to all enemies equal to #1[i]% of Khaslana's ATK, and additionally deals #3[i] instance(s) of DMG, with each instance being Physical DMG equal to #4[i]% of Khaslana's ATK dealt to one random enemy. Afterward, "Soulscorch" is dispelled. Each "Soulscorch" stack increases the DMG multiplier of said Counter by #5[i]% of its original multiplier value.
DMG dealt through this ability is considered as Skill DMG. If "Soulscorch" is still active at the start of Khaslana's extra turn, immediately launches Counter.

This Skill does not consume Skill Points.
This Skill uses a separate keybind from the standard Skill keybind, being W on PC, on Xbox, and on PlayStation. This binding cannot be changed.

Dispels all debuffs on this unit, then deals Physical DMG equal to a max of #5[i]% of Khaslana's ATK.
For every 1 point of "Scourge" consumed, deals #3[i] instance(s) of DMG, with each instance being Physical DMG equal to #2[f1]% of Khaslana's ATK dealt to one random enemy. When consuming #4[i] point(s) of "Scourge", additionally deals Physical DMG equal to #1[i]% of Khaslana's ATK, which is evenly distributed across all enemies.
140811.notes:
This ability does not consume Skill Points.
This ability requires at least one point of "Scourge"ScourgeKhaslana's exclusive charge with an upper limit of 7. Will be retained even before transforming. to execute.

1.name: Fire and Light Bind Virtue and Vice

The base SPD inheritance ratio for Khaslana's extra turn increases to 66%. For every enemy target defeated in one battle, additionally increases this ratio by 1.5%, up to a max of 84%.
When using Ultimate, increases CRIT DMG by 50%, lasting for 3 turn(s).

3.desc:
Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.

4.desc: When using "Calamity: Soulscorch Edict," additionally gains 4 stack(s) of "Soulscorch."

5.desc:
Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.

When receiving an Energy Regeneration effect from a teammate's ability, gains 1 point(s) of "Coreflame."

10000000.desc: Gain 1 extra turn that won't expend your remaining turns when taking action. During this extra turn, no Ultimate can be used.

141302.desc: Consumes #6[i]% of Evernight's current HP to summon memosprite Evey and increases CRIT DMG of all ally memosprites by an amount equal to #1[i]% of Evernight's CRIT DMG for #2[i] turn(s). This duration decreases by 1 at the start of Evernight's every turn. If Evey is already on the field, restores its HP by #4[i]% of its Max HP. When using this, gains #3[i] point(s) of "Memoria." If in the "Darkest Riddle" state, gains #5[i] additional point(s) of "Memoria."
141302.notes: This ability does not consume Skill Points.

141303.name: O Wakeful World, Goodnight
141303.desc: Summons memosprite Evey. Then Evey deals Ice DMG to all enemies equal to #1[i]% of Evey's Max HP and Evernight enters the "Darkest Riddle" state. During this state, all enemies take #4[i]% increased DMG while both Evernight and Evey deal #3[i]% increased DMG and are immune to Crowd Control debuffs. Gains #2[i] point(s) of Charge for "Darkest Riddle." And Evey consumes 1 point after it uses "Dream, Dissolving, as Dew." At the start of Evernight's turn, if no Charge remains, exits the "Darkest Riddle" state.
141303.notes: Evey is the attacker of this ability.

141304.name: With Me, This Night
141304.desc:
When entering combat, summons memosprite Evey. Evey has an initial SPD of #4[i] and its Max HP equals to #5[i]% of that of Evernight's. Each time Evernight or Evey loses HP, increases CRIT DMG for Evernight and Evey by #2[i]% for #3[i] turn(s), and gains #1[i] "Memoria." This effect can trigger only once per target for each received attack.
When Evernight has #6[i] or more points of "Memoria," dispels Crowd Control debuffs and becomes immune to them. If Evey is on the field, it immediately takes action. The immediate action effect can only trigger again after Evey uses "Dream, Dissolving, as Dew."

141306.name: Attack
141306.desc: Attacks an enemy, and after entering combat, reduces their Toughness of the corresponding Type.

141307.name: Let it Rain Cold On Thee
141307.desc: After using Technique, at the start of the next battle, obtains the same effect as the one from Skill that increases CRIT DMG for all ally memosprites, and gains #1[i] "Memoria."

141309.name: Day Gently Slips
141309.notes: This ability does not consume Skill Points.

1.name: Sleep Tight, the Night Dreams Long
1.desc: When Evernight is on the field, if there are (≥4)/3/2/1 enemy targets on the field, ally memosprites deal DMG equal to 120%/125%/130%/150% of their original DMG respectively.

2.name: Listen Up, the Slumber Speaks Soft
2.desc: Increases Evernight's and the memosprite Evey's CRIT DMG by 40%. Each time Evernight gains "Memoria," increases the amount of "Memoria" gain by 2 point(s). When using Ultimate, additionally gains 2 Charge for "Darkest Riddle."

3.name: Fear Not, the Nightmare Lies Past
3.desc:
Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.
Memosprite Talent Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.

4.name: Wake Up, the Tomorrow is Yours
4.desc: While Evernight is on the field, ally memosprites' Weakness Break Efficiency increases by 25%, and the memosprite Evey's Weakness Break Efficiency additionally increases by 25%.

5.name: Let Go, the "Me" in Memories
5.desc:
Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Memosprite Skill Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.

6.name: Like This, Always
6.desc: While Evernight is on the field, all ally targets' All-Type RES PEN increases by 20%. After the memosprite Evey uses "Dream, Dissolving, as Dew," Evernight gains 30% of the amount of "Memoria" consumed in this attack.

1141301.name: Remembrance, Whirling, Like Rain
1141301.desc: This ability automatically selects a target, prioritizing the enemy target that Evernight last attacked. Deals Ice DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Evey's Max HP to one enemy. For every <unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak> point(s) of "Memoria" Evernight currently has, additionally deals Ice DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[f1]%</unbreak></color> of Evey's Max HP. Gains <unbreak>#4[i]</unbreak> point(s) of "Memoria" after use.
1141301.simple_desc: Deals minor Ice DMG to one enemy and further deals minor Ice DMG based on the amount of "Memoria."
1141301.notes: This ability's DMG is dealt in 6 hits. The DMG distribution across hits is 10% + 10% + 10% + 10% + 10% + 50%.

1141303.name: Solitude, Drifting, In Murk
1141303.desc: Evey is immune to <u>Crowd Control debuffs</u> and has an increased chance of getting attacked. While Evey is on the field, Evernight and Evey deal <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> increased DMG.
1141303.simple_desc: The memosprite Evey is immune to <u>Crowd Control debuffs</u>, and its chance of getting attacked increases. While it's on the field, increases its own and Evernight's DMG dealt.

10000011.name: Crowd Control debuff
10000011.desc: Freeze, Entanglement, Imprisonment, Dominance, Outrage, Strong Reverberation, Alien Dream, Snarelock, Terrified, Action Lock, Happiness Puppet, Grudge Ablaze.

1141303.notes: This ability increases Evey's Aggro by 300%.

1141305.name: Night, Trailing, In Step
1141305.desc: When summoned, this unit immediately takes action.
1141305.simple_desc: When summoned, this unit immediately takes action.

1141306.name: You, Parting, Beyond Reach
1141306.desc: Upon disappearing, increases Evernight's SPD by <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak>. If the disappearance is due to using "Dream, Dissolving, as Dew," then, for every 1 "Memoria" point consumed by the attack, additionally increases Evernight's SPD by <unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak>. Up to <unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak> "Memoria" points can be taken into account for this. The SPD Boost effect cannot stack and is removed at the start of Evernight's next turn.

1141307.name: Dream, Dissolving, as Dew
1141307.desc: This ability is used when Evernight's "Memoria" is greater than or equal to <unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak> and she is not affected by Crowd Control. For every 1 "Memoria" point currently held, deals Ice DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[f1]%</unbreak></color> of Evey's Max HP to the primary target, and Ice DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[f1]%</unbreak></color> of Evey's Max HP to the other enemy targets. After use, consumes all "Memoria" and HP, and makes Evey disappear.
1141307.simple_desc: <color=#f29e38ff>Based on the amount of "Memoria"</color>, deals massive Ice DMG to the primary target and Ice DMG to the other enemy targets. After use, <color=#f29e38ff>consumes all "Memoria" and HP, and makes Evey disappear</color>.
1141307.notes:
The player can select the primary target of this ability.
When this ability is used, Evernight is considered as dealing a killing blow to Evey.‍[verification needed]

bonus_abilities.name: Dark the Night, Still the Moon
bonus_abilities.desc: Increases Evernight's and the memosprite Evey's CRIT Rate by 35%. When using an ability, consumes 5% of this unit's current HP to increase CRIT DMG for both of them by 15%, lasting for 2 turn(s). After Evey uses "Dream, Dissolving, as Dew," recovers 1 Skill Point for allies.

bonus_abilities.name: Rouse the Flame, Lull the Light
bonus_abilities.desc: When combat starts, Evernight regenerates 70 Energy and gains 1 "Memoria." When Evernight or an ally memosprite uses an ability, Evernight regenerates 5 Energy and gains 1 "Memoria."

bonus_abilities.name: Kindle the Morn, Drop the Rain
bonus_abilities.desc: When there are 1/2/3/≥4 Remembrance characters in the team, increases CRIT DMG for all ally memosprites by 5%/15%/50%/65% respectively while Evernight's Skill lasts.

141401.name: Aegis Vitae
141401.desc: Deals Physical DMG equal to #1[i]% of Dan Heng • Permansor Terrae's ATK to one designated enemy.
141401.notes: This ability's DMG is dealt in 2 hits. The DMG distribution across hits is 30% + 70%.

141402.name: Terra Omnibus
141402.desc:
Designates one ally character as the "Bondmate" and provides all allies with a Shield that can offset DMG equal to #1[f1]% of Dan Heng • Permansor Terrae's ATK plus #2[i] for #3[i] turn(s). When repeatedly receiving Dan Heng • Permansor Terrae's Shield, can stack the Shield Effect, but it will not exceed #4[i]% of the current Shield provided by Skill.
"Bondmate" only applies to the most recent target of Dan Heng • Permansor Terrae's Skill.

141403.name: A Dragon's Zenith Knows No Rue
141403.desc:
Deals Physical DMG equal to #1[i]% of Dan Heng • Permansor Terrae's ATK to all enemies, and provides a Shield to all allies that can offset DMG equal to #4[f1]% of Dan Heng • Permansor Terrae's ATK plus #5[i], lasting for #6[i] turn(s). When repeatedly receiving Dan Heng • Permansor Terrae's Shield, can stack the Shield Effect, but it will not exceed #7[i]% of the current Shield provided by Skill.
"Souldragon" becomes enhanced. When "Souldragon" takes action, launches Follow-Up ATK, dealing Physical DMG to all enemies equal to #2[i]% of Dan Heng • Permansor Terrae's ATK and Additional DMG of the Bondmate's Type to all enemies equal to #8[f1]% of the Bondmate's ATK. The enhancement lasts for #3[i] "Souldragon" action(s).
141403.notes:
The Ultimate DMG is dealt in 1 hit.
The Follow-Up Attack DMG of Souldragon is dealt in 4 hits. The DMG distribution across hits is 25% + 25% + 25% + 25%.
Using this Ultimate increases the number of actions for the enhanced Souldragon by 2.
Dan Heng • Permansor Terrae's second Eidolon, Watch Trails to Blaze, additionally increases the number of actions for the enhanced Souldragon from Ultimate by 2.

141404.name: Of Virtue, Forms Unfold
141404.desc:
When an ally character becomes the "Bondmate," Dan Heng • Permansor Terrae summons "Souldragon" for them, which has an initial SPD of #5[i].
When "Souldragon" takes action, dispels #6[i] debuff(s) from all allies and provides a Shield that can offset DMG equal to #1[f1]% of Dan Heng • Permansor Terrae's ATK plus #2[i] for #3[i] turn(s). The Shield Effect provided by Dan Heng • Permansor Terrae and "Souldragon" can be stacked, but it will not exceed #4[i]% of the Shield provided by Dan Heng • Permansor Terrae's Skill.
When Dan Heng • Permansor Terrae or the "Bondmate" is knocked down, "Souldragon" disappears.

141406.name: Attack
141406.desc: Attacks an enemy, and after entering combat, reduces their Toughness of the corresponding Type.

141407.name: Earthrend
141407.desc:
After using Technique, gains "Bondmate" and inflict Daze on enemies within a certain area for #1[i] second(s). Dazed enemies will not actively attack ally targets.
When switching the active character, "Bondmate" transfers to the current active character. At the start of the next battle, automatically uses Skill 1 time on the character with "Bondmate" without consuming any Skill Points.

1.name: Shed Scales of Old
1.desc: When Dan Heng • Permansor Terrae uses Ultimate, recovers 1 Skill Point(s) and increases the "Bondmate's" All-Type RES PEN by 18%, lasting for 3 turn(s).

2.name: Watch Trails to Blaze
2.desc: Additionally increases the number of actions for the enhanced Souldragon from Ultimate by 2. After Dan Heng • Permansor Terrae uses Ultimate, Souldragon advances action by 100%. When the enhanced "Souldragon" takes action, the Additional DMG dealt by the "Bondmate" becomes 200% of its original DMG, and the Shield Effect provided in this instance becomes 200% of its original Shield Effect.

3.name: Bear Weight of Worlds
3.desc:
Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.

4.name: By Oath, This Vessel Is I
4.desc: Reduces the DMG taken by the "Bondmate" by 20%.

5.name: The Path of Permanence Sweeps Far
5.desc:
Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.

6.name: One Dream to Enfold All Wilds
6.desc: When the "Bondmate" is on the field, increases the DMG taken by all enemies by 20%. When the "Bondmate" deals DMG, ignores 12% of the enemy targets' DEF. When Dan Heng • Permansor Terrae uses Ultimate, the "Bondmate" will deal Additional DMG of the Bondmate's Type to all enemies, equal to 330% of the Bondmate's ATK.

bonus_abilities.name: Empyreanity
bonus_abilities.desc: When using Skill, increases ATK for the target who has become "Bondmate" by an amount equal to 15% of Dan Heng • Permansor Terrae's ATK.

bonus_abilities.name: Sylvanity
bonus_abilities.desc: When combat starts, Dan Heng • Permansor Terrae advances action by 40%. When the "Bondmate" uses an attack, Dan Heng • Permansor Terrae regenerates 6 Energy and "Souldragon" advances action by 15%.

bonus_abilities.name: Sublimity
bonus_abilities.desc: When "Souldragon" takes action, additionally provides a Shield that can offset DMG equal to 5% of Dan Heng • Permansor Terrae's ATK plus 100 to the ally target whose current Shield Effect is the lowest. When repeatedly receiving Dan Heng • Permansor Terrae's Shield, can stack the Shield Effect, but it will not exceed 300% of the current Shield provided by Skill. When the enhanced "Souldragon" takes action, additionally deals 1 instance of Additional DMG of the Bondmate's Type to the one enemy target whose current HP is the highest, equal to 40% of the Bondmate's ATK.

141501.name: Lo, Hope Takes Flight!
141501.desc: Gains #2[i] "Recollection" point(s) and deals Ice DMG equal to #1[i]% of Cyrene's Max HP to one designated enemy.

141502.name: Bloom, Elysium of Beyond
141502.desc: Gains #3[i] "Recollection" point(s) and deploys a Zone that lasts for #2[i] turns. The Zone's duration decreases by 1 at the start of Cyrene's every turn. While the Zone lasts, for each instance of DMG dealt by all ally targets, deals 1 additional instance of True DMG equal to #1[i]% of the original DMG. When Cyrene is downed, the Zone will also be dispelled.

141503.name: Verse ◦ Vow ∞
141503.desc:
Summons memosprite Demiurge, causes it to immediately gain 1 extra turn, and activates all teammates' Ultimate. Then, enters the "Ripples of Past Reverie" state. Enhances Basic ATK to "To Love and Tomorrow ♪" and can only use this Basic ATK. Increases Cyrene's and Demiurge's CRIT Rate by #3[i]%, and deploys the Zone effect from Skill with no duration limit.
Can only be used once per battle. Demiurge's initial Max HP equals to #1[i]% of Cyrene's Max HP.
141503.notes:
Verse ◦ Vow ∞ consumes 12 "Recollection" points, but requires a minimum 24 "Recollection" points to use. After using Verse ◦ Vow ∞, Cyrene will have at least 12 "Recollection" points remaining, allowing her to immediately use Reunion at First Sight once afterward.
If Cyrene's Ultimate is activated through other effects such as Brain in a Vat in Simulated Universe and Ruinous Embers in Apocalyptic Shadow, her Recollection points will increase to 24, allowing her to use Reunion at First Sight twice in a row.

141504.name: Hearts Gather as One
141504.desc: When combat begins or after Cyrene takes action, other ally characters under any state and their memosprites gain "Future." When ally targets with "Future" take action, consumes "Future" to grant Cyrene #1[i] "Recollection" point(s). When Cyrene has #4[i] "Recollection" points, can activate Ultimate and dispel all debuffs on her. When she has #5[i] "Recollection" points during the "Ripples of Past Reverie" state, can activate Ultimate. After reaching the maximum, it can overflow by up to #3[i] points. While Cyrene is on the field, increases DMG dealt by all ally targets by #2[f1]%.

141506.name: Attack
141506.desc: Attacks an enemy, and after entering combat, reduces their Toughness of the corresponding Type.

141507.name: Peace at West Wind's End
141507.desc: After using Technique, creates a Special Dimension that lasts for #1[i] second(s) around the character. Enemies within this Special Dimension enter the "This Moment, Forever" state. While in this state, enemies will cease all actions. Ally characters within this Special Dimension have #2[i]% increased movement speed. After entering combat within the duration, deploys the Skill's Zone. Only 1 Dimension Effect created by allies can exist at the same time.
141507.notes:
While Cyrene's Special Dimension is active, her regular overworld attack of shooting arrows is replaced by a ranged attack via making a hand heart.
If Trailblazer (Remembrance) is in the team, entering combat against an enemy in the "This Moment, Forever" state will trigger the Trailblazer's Technique, Memories Back as Echoes, even if it wasn't used. This can be avoided by attacking an enemy just outside the range of Cyrene's Special Dimension, which will still allow her Skill's Zone to be deployed.

141508.name: To Love and Tomorrow ♪
141508.desc:
Gains #2[i] "Recollection" points and deals Ice DMG equal to #3[i]% of Cyrene's Max HP to one designated enemy. Then, deals Ice DMG equal to #1[i]% of Cyrene's Max HP to all enemies.
"To Love and Tomorrow ♪" cannot recover Skill Points.
141508.notes:
This ability's AoE DMG is dealt in 2 hits. The DMG distribution across hits is 30% + 70%.
This ability can trigger the Physical DoT of Hysilens's Ultimate, Maelstrom Rhapsody.

141514.name: <unbreak>Reunion at</unbreak> <unbreak>First Sight</unbreak>
141514.desc: Enables Demiurge to immediately gain 1 extra turn.

141519.name: Attack
141519.desc: Attacks an enemy, and after entering combat, reduces their Toughness of the corresponding Type.

1.name: Epics, Born on a Blank Slate
1.desc: When Demiurge triggers the Memosprite Skill "Ode to Ego" during the use of "Minuet of Blooms and Plumes," gains 6 "Recollection" point(s) and increases the number of bounces for this attack by 12.

2.name: A Tomorrow in Thirteen Shades
2.desc: When entering combat, additionally gains 12 "Recollection" point(s). For every 1 different ally character that gains the Memosprite Skill buff from Demiurge, the DMG multiplier for the True DMG dealt by ally targets via the Skill's Zone increases by 6%, up to a max increase of 24%.

3.name: By Thy Being, As I've Written
3.desc:
Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Memosprite Skill Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.

4.name: Please Write On, With a Smile
4.desc: After every 1 use of "Minuet of Blooms and Plumes" by Demiurge, the Bounce DMG multiplier for the triggered Memosprite Skill "Ode to Ego" increases by 6% in the current battle, stacking up to 24 times.

5.name: Gaze, Steeped in Yesterbloom
5.desc:
Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.
Memosprite Talent Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.

6.name: Remembrance, Sung in Ripples ♪
6.desc:
When Cyrene uses Ultimate for the first time, all allies advance action by 100%. Each time Demiurge triggers the Memosprite Skill "Ode to Ego" during the use of "Minuet of Blooms and Plumes," gains the following effects based on the number of times it has been triggered in the current battle:
1 time: When Demiurge is on the field, reduces all enemy targets' DEF by 20%.
2 times and more: All allies advance action by 24%.

1141501.name: Minuet of Blooms and Plumes
1141501.desc: Deals Ice DMG to all enemies equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Demiurge's Max HP.
1141501.simple_desc: Deals Ice DMG to all enemies.

1141502.name: This Ode, to All Lives
1141502.desc: Applies a <u>buff</u> to one designated ally character. When the character is a <u>Chrysos Heir</u>, the target gains a <color=#f9b0f0><u><unbreak><icon SpriteName=AvatarCyrene id=0 width=1 height=1>special</unbreak> effect</u></color>. When the character is not a <u>Chrysos Heir</u>, increases the target's DMG dealt by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color> for <unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak> turns. This effect also applies on memosprites.
1141502.simple_desc: Applies a <u>buff</u> to one ally character. When the character is a <u>Chrysos Heir</u>, the target gains a <color=#f9b0f0><u><unbreak><icon SpriteName=AvatarCyrene id=0 width=1 height=1>special</unbreak> effect</u></color>. When the character is not a <u>Chrysos Heir</u>, increases the target's DMG dealt. This effect also applies on memosprites.

10000009.name: Buff
10000009.desc: All status effects that provide beneficial combat buffs, can be dispelled unless stated otherwise.

10000025.name: Chrysos Heir
10000025.desc: Cyrene, Tribbie, Cerydra, Evernight, Dan Heng • Permansor Terrae, Hysilens, Hyacine, Phainon, Anaxa, Aglaea, Mydei, Castorice, Cipher, Trailblazer (Remembrance).

1141502.notes:
The special effects granted to each Chrysos Heir when this ability is used on them are as follows:
Trailblazer (Remembrance): Ode to Genesis
Aglaea: Ode to Romance
Tribbie: Ode to Passage
Mydei: Ode to Strife
Castorice: Ode to Life and Death
Anaxa: Ode to Reason
Hyacine: Ode to Sky
Cipher: Ode to Trickery
Phainon: Ode to Worldbearing
Hysilens: Ode to Ocean
Cerydra: Ode to Law
Evernight: Ode to Time
Dan Heng • Permansor Terrae: Ode to Earth
Ode to Ego is also listed as a special effect corresponding to Cyrene.

1141503.name: Waiting, In Every Past
1141503.desc: Demiurge's SPD remains at 0, and it will not appear on the Action Order. While on the field, it is considered as <u>Out-of-Bounds</u>. When Cyrene's HP percentage changes, Demiurge's HP percentage will also change accordingly. While Demiurge is on the field, Cyrene's and Demiurge's Max HP increases by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color>. After Demiurge uses abilities, decreases the duration of all <u>Continuous Effects</u> on this unit by 1.
1141503.simple_desc: When changes occur on Cyrene's HP, Demiurge's HP will also change accordingly. While Demiurge is on the field, Cyrene's Max HP increases.

10000024.name: Out-of-Bounds
10000024.desc: Neither allies nor enemies can actively select Out-of-Bounds units.

10000022.name: Continuous Effect
10000022.desc: Includes buffs, debuffs, and other effects.

1141505.name: "Hello, World ♪"
1141505.desc: When Demiurge is summoned, dispels <u>Crowd Control debuffs</u> from all allies.
1141505.simple_desc: When summoned, dispels <u>Crowd Control debuffs</u> from all allies.

10000011.name: Crowd Control debuff
10000011.desc: Freeze, Entanglement, Imprisonment, Dominance, Outrage, Strong Reverberation, Alien Dream, Snarelock, Terrified, Action Lock, Happiness Puppet, Grudge Ablaze.

1141513.name: Ode to Genesis
1141513.desc: <color=#f29e38ff>Effective for the entire battle</color>. When used on Trailblazer (Remembrance), increases Trailblazer (Remembrance)'s ATK by an amount equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Demiurge's Max HP, and increases Trailblazer (Remembrance)'s CRIT Rate by an amount equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color> of Demiurge's CRIT Rate. This effect also applies to Mem. After Trailblazer (Remembrance) uses Enhanced Basic ATK in this battle, Demiurge immediately gains 1 <u>extra turn</u> and automatically uses "Minuet of Blooms and Plumes." If the target was defeated before this ability is used, it will be used on newly appeared enemy targets instead.
1141513.simple_desc: <color=#f29e38ff>Effective for the entire battle</color>. When used on Trailblazer (Remembrance), increases Trailblazer (Remembrance)'s ATK and CRIT Rate. This effect also applies to Mem. After Trailblazer (Remembrance) uses Enhanced Basic ATK, Demiurge immediately gains 1 <u>extra turn</u> and automatically uses "Minuet of Blooms and Plumes."

10000000.name: Extra Turn
10000000.desc: Gain 1 extra turn that won't expend your remaining turns when taking action. During this extra turn, no Ultimate can be used.

1141514.name: Ode to Romance
1141514.desc: <color=#f29e38ff>One-time effect</color>. When used on Aglaea, causes Aglaea to gain "Romance" and immediately stacks Garmentmaker's Memosprite Talent's SPD Boost effect to its upper limit. After Aglaea or Garmentmaker uses an attack, consumes "Romance" and regenerates <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> Energy. Increases DMG dealt by Aglaea and Garmentmaker by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color>, and ignores <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak></color> of the targets' DEF, lasting until Aglaea exits the "Supreme Stance" state.
1141514.simple_desc: <color=#f29e38ff>One-time effect</color>. When used on Aglaea, immediately stacks Aglaea's Memosprite Talent's SPD Boost effect to its upper limit. After Aglaea or Garmentmaker uses an attack, regenerates Energy. Increases DMG dealt by Aglaea and Garmentmaker, and ignores targets' DEF.

1141515.name: Ode to Passage
1141515.desc: <color=#f29e38ff>Effective for the entire battle</color>. When used on Tribbie, causes DMG dealt by Tribbie to ignore <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color> of enemies' DEF. When Tribbie launches Follow-Up ATK and triggers the <u>Additional DMG</u> from Tribbie's Zone, it further deals <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> instance(s) of Additional DMG.
1141515.simple_desc: <color=#f29e38ff>Effective for the entire battle</color>. When used on Tribbie, causes DMG dealt by Tribbie to ignore enemies' DEF. When Tribbie launches Follow-Up ATK and triggers the <u>Additional DMG</u> from Tribbie's Zone, it further deals <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak></color> instance(s) of Additional DMG.

10000005.name: Additional DMG
10000005.desc: Causes the target being hit to take extra DMG, which is not considered an attack.

1141516.name: Ode to Strife
1141516.desc: <color=#f29e38ff>One-time effect</color>. When used on Mydei, removes all <u>Crowd Control debuffs</u> inflicted on him. And if Mydei is in the "Vendetta" state, he automatically uses 1 instance of "Godslayer Be God" without consuming Charge. The AoE DMG is dealt in 4 hits. The DMG distribution across hits is 25% + 25% + 25% + 25%.

Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.

5.desc:
Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.

150904.desc:

150905.desc:
When Gilgamesh or Saber attacks, the attack tally increases by 1. After any unit attacks, if the attack tally reaches #5[i], Gilgamesh and Saber launch Joint Follow-Up ATK, dealing Lightning DMG equal to #1[i]% of Gilgamesh's ATK and Wind DMG equal to #2[i]% of Saber's ATK to all enemies, respectively. Then, Gilgamesh gains #3[i] "Interest." Saber regenerates a fixed #4[i] Energy, and the next time she uses Ultimate, the DMG dealt becomes #6[i]% of the original DMG.
After using Joint Follow-Up ATK, resets the attack tally.

Gilgamesh's attack deals 10 Toughness Reduction. Gilgamesh's DMG is dealt in 4 hits. The DMG distribution across hits is 18% + 18% + 18% + 46%.

150906.name: Attack
150906.desc: Attacks an enemy, and after entering combat, reduces their Toughness of the corresponding Type.

When entering combat by actively attacking an enemy in the "King's Permission" state, causes all enemies in the "King's Permission" state to enter combat, and deals Lightning DMG equal to #2[i]% of Gilgamesh's ATK to all enemies after entering combat. Gilgamesh also immediately gains #3[i] "Interest." Only 1 Dimension Effect created by allies can exist at the same time.

150909.name: Halfhearted Blow

1.name: He Who Saw the Deep
1.desc: When Gilgamesh holds "King's Acknowledgement," its DEF-ignoring effect also applies to other teammates, and "King's Acknowledgement" additionally increases Gilgamesh's ATK by 60%. When using Skill, additionally regenerates a fixed 40 Energy.

2.name: Wisdom That Encompassed All
2.desc: When entering combat, Gilgamesh gains 5 "Interest." When using Ultimate, additionally gains 5 "Interest." The DMG multiplier of the Skill "Gate of Babylon" against the primary target increases by 100%, and its DMG multiplier against adjacent targets increases by 50%.

3.name: Journey That Spanned Far

Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.

5.name: Sword That Parted Gods from Man
5.desc:
Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.

6.name: Soul That Bore Friendship

When a teammate uses Ultimate, Gilgamesh gains 1 point of "Golden Rule," up to a total of 3 points. When this unit uses Ultimate, consumes all "Golden Rule" points, and each point of "Golden Rule" consumed increases the CRIT DMG for the Ultimate DMG dealt by 100%.

bonus_abilities.desc: When Gilgamesh uses Ultimate, gains 2 "Interest." When other ally characters use Ultimate, Gilgamesh additionally gains 2 "Interest" and regenerates a fixed amount of Energy equal to 30% of the Energy consumed this time.

bonus_abilities.name: Hero's Hauteur
bonus_abilities.desc: During the current battle, for every 1 point of "Interest" gained by Gilgamesh, increases his CRIT DMG by 25%. This effect can stack up to 6 time(s).

bonus_abilities.name: Hegemon's Strife
bonus_abilities.desc: While Gilgamesh is on the field, increases all ally targets' ATK by 20% and CRIT DMG by 20%. If the target's Max Energy exceeds 140, for every 1 excess point of Max Energy, additionally increases ATK and CRIT DMG by 1%, up to a maximum additional increase of 100%.

name: Himeko • Nova

151001.name: Enkindle the First Lodestar
151001.desc: Deals Fire DMG equal to #1[i]% of Himeko • Nova's ATK to one enemy.

151002.name: Upraise the Vanward Cresset
151002.desc: After using Skill, immediately recovers all Assist Skill uses. Himeko • Nova gains "Navigator's Semaphore," lasting for #2[i] turn(s). This duration decreases by 1 at the start of Himeko • Nova's every turn. When Himeko • Nova has "Navigator's Semaphore," DMG dealt by all allies increases by #1[i]%. At the start of every turn, immediately recovers 1 Assist Skill use.
151002.notes: The use(s) of Assist Skill Trailblaze, By Your Side will be regained before the duration of Navigator's Semaphore is depleted.

151003.name: We, Too, Stride the Stars
151003.desc:
Immediately takes control of "Starblazer." "Starblazer" can launch "Hyperluminal Particle Beam" against enemies 6 times, or consume "Source Energy" to launch "Orbital Annihilation Pulse," dealing Fire DMG up to #9[i]% of Himeko • Nova's ATK to one designated enemy, and Fire DMG up to #10[i]% of Himeko • Nova's ATK to other targets.
When the uses of "Hyperluminal Particle Beam" are depleted, automatically launches "Orbital Annihilation Pulse," followed by Final Hit, dealing #6[i] instance(s) of DMG, with each instance dealing Fire DMG equal to #7[i]% of Himeko • Nova's ATK to one random enemy.
When "Hyperluminal Particle Beam" or "Orbital Annihilation Pulse" deals fatal damage to all enemies on the field, or when enemy HP can no longer be reduced, immediately launches Final Hit.
151003.notes:
If all current enemies are defeated during the progression of the Ultimate when facing enemies (either as part of respawning enemies or wave formats), the remaining use(s) of Hyperluminal Particle Beam will be held off until the remaining enemies arrive, and the Starblazer will continue the Ultimate.
When launching the Final Hit, the screen loads the teammates' Level 4 Eidolon images.

151004.name: Of Fire and Far Faring
151004.desc:
While Himeko • Nova is on the field, immediately deploys the Territory "Starblazer Visioscape," summoning "Starblazer" to the field and granting all ally characters 1 Assist Skill use. Ally characters can use Assist Skill to call upon "Starblazer" to attack enemies.
Using Assist Skill is considered as Himeko • Nova using her Skill. Himeko • Nova gains #2[i]% increased All-Type RES PEN and #1[i]% increased CRIT DMG. When attacking, can ignore Weakness Types to reduce enemy Toughness. When breaking Weakness, triggers the Fire Weakness Break effect.
When ally characters other than Himeko • Nova use their Assist Skill, regenerates #3[i] Energy for them.

151006.name: Attack
151006.desc: Attacks an enemy, and after entering combat, reduces their Toughness of the corresponding Type.

After using Technique, enters the "Cruise" state for #1[i] seconds. Actively using the Technique consumes 2 Technique Points and immediately attacks all enemies within a certain range. After entering combat, immediately uses Skill 1 time at the start of each wave.
If attacking a Normal Enemy, immediately defeats them without entering combat. No Technique Points are consumed if no enemies are hit.
151007.notes:
During the "Cruise" state, Himeko • Nova can quit the state by pressing the Technique button, which does not consume Technique Points.
Triggering combat with this Technique does not reduce Toughness.

151008.desc: Deals Fire DMG equal to #1[i]% of Himeko • Nova's ATK to all enemies and gains #2[i] point(s) of "Source Energy." A maximum of #3[i] "Source Energy" can be held.

151022.desc:
Deals Fire DMG equal to #1[i]% of Himeko • Nova's ATK to all enemies, and additionally deals #2[i] instances of DMG, with each instance dealing Fire DMG equal to #3[i]% of Himeko • Nova's ATK to one random enemy. If the user is a Trailblaze Companions character other than Himeko • Nova, then depending on the user, Himeko • Nova additionally gains 1 of the <icon SpriteName=AvatarHimekoNova id=0 width=1 height=1>Special Effects.
The extra Assist Skill via all <icon SpriteName=AvatarHimekoNova id=1 width=1 height=1>Special Effects can be launched up to #8[i] time(s) per battle, and this count is reset after Himeko • Nova uses her Ultimate.

The Starblazer can still launch the Assist Skill if Himeko • Nova is affected by Crowd Control effects.
The Special Effects Companion Protocol: Verdict and Companion Protocol: Decimation are mutually exclusive. When switching Special Effects, the previous one's charge will be kept.

151025.desc: Enters the "Companion Protocol: Verdict" state. Increases DMG dealt by Himeko • Nova by #8[i]%, and additionally increases her Ultimate DMG dealt by #10[i]%. Sunday

5.desc:
Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.

151201.desc: Deals Wind DMG equal to #1[i]% of Robin • Summeretto's Max HP to one enemy.

This lasts for 2 turn(s), and its duration decreases by 1 at the start of this character's turn.

151204.name: Wings Heed No Borders
151204.desc:
Memosprite "Summer Songbirds" has an initial Max HP equal to #1[i]% of Robin • Summeretto's Max HP and an initial SPD equal to #2[i]% of Robin • Summeretto's SPD. When an ally target uses an attack, or when they provide healing or Shield for the first time in any target's turn, Robin • Summeretto gains Vibes by 1 point, capped at #5[i]. While "Summer Songbirds" Bessie is on the field, if Robin • Summeretto's Vibes is #6[i] or higher, immediately summons "Summer Songbirds" Drummie, and if Vibes is #7[i] or higher, immediately summons "Summer Songbirds" Paddie. When all "Summer Songbirds" take the stage, dispels all Crowd Control debuffs inflicted upon Robin • Summeretto and the "Summer Songbirds", starts the "Fever" state, and deploys a Zone. When ally targets deal DMG within the Zone, they ignore a percentage of enemy targets' DEF equal to (#8[f1]% + Vibes × #9[f1]%).
While in the "Fever" state, Robin • Summeretto and the "Summer Songbirds" are immune to Crowd Control debuffs. Robin • Summeretto will not enter her turn until the "Fever" state ends.

151206.name: Attack

151207.desc: After using Technique, advances action by #3[i]% at the start of the next battle, immediately gains #1[i] Vibes, and increases all allies' DMG dealt by #2[i]%, lasting for 2 turn(s).

1.desc: "Summer Songbirds" will keep a tally of 100% of the non-True DMG dealt by ally targets. When using the Memosprite Skill, additionally deals True DMG to the enemy target with the highest HP, equal to (11% + current Vibes × 0.1%) of the total tally. Then, clears 50% of the tally.

2.name: A Heart of Still Water
2.desc: Ally targets' All-Type RES PEN increases by 18%. The upper limit of Robin • Summeretto's Vibes increases by 20. The first time an ally target uses an ability during any target's turn to cause Robin • Summeretto to gain Vibes, she gains an additional 2 points.

Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Memosprite Talent Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.

Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.
Memosprite Skill Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.

After entering the "Fever" state for the first time in this battle or when the the "Fever" countdown's turn starts, regenerates a fixed 140 Energy.

1151203.desc: While in the "Fever" state, the "Summer Songbirds" and a countdown will appear on the Action Order. And the DMG dealt by Robin • Summeretto and "Summer Songbirds" increases by an amount equal to (<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> + Vibes × <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[f1]%</unbreak></color>). When "Summer Songbirds'" turn starts, uses the Memosprite Skill. The countdown has an initial SPD of <unbreak>#9[i]</unbreak>. And when its turn starts, deducts <unbreak>#10[i]%</unbreak> of the current Vibes (minimum <unbreak>#6[i]</unbreak> points). When the Vibes reaches 0, the "Summer Songbirds" disappears and Robin • Summeretto exits the "Fever" state. While the "Summer Songbirds" is on the field, based on the number of its members present, increases the DMG taken by all enemies by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[f1]%</unbreak></color>/<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#4[f1]%</unbreak></color>/<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#5[f1]%</unbreak></color> respectively.
1151203.simple_desc: While in the "Fever" state, Robin • Summeretto and the "Summer Songbirds" increase their DMG dealt. When the "Summer Songbirds'" turn starts, uses Memosprite Skill. When Vibes reaches 0, "Summer Songbirds" disappears, and Robin • Summeretto exits the "Fever" state. While the "Summer Songbirds" is on the field, increases the DMG taken by all enemies based on the number of its members present.

1151205.name: Near the Sea's Heartbeat
1151205.desc: When the "Summer Songbirds" gets summoned, regenerates <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> Energy for Robin • Summeretto.
1151205.simple_desc: When summoned, regenerates Energy for Robin • Summeretto.

1151206.desc: When the "Summer Songbirds" disappears, Robin • Summeretto's <u>action advances</u> by <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak>.
1151206.simple_desc: When disappearing, causes Robin • Summeretto to <u>advance action</u>.

800703.name: Together, Mem!

Mem is the attacker of this ability.

800704.name: Almighty Companion
800704.desc: Memosprite Mem has an initial SPD of #1[i] and a Max HP equal to #2[i]% of Trailblazer's Max HP plus #4[i]. For every #3[i] Energy regenerated by all allies in total, Mem gains 1% Charge.

800706.name: Attack

800707.name: Memories Back as Echoes

800708.name: Together, We Script Tomorrow!

Mem's attack deals 5 Toughness Reduction. Mem's DMG is dealt in 1 hit.

2.name: Gleaner of the Past

Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Memosprite Talent Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.

5.name: Seamster of the Ode

Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.

1800705.name: Go, Mem, Go!
1800705.desc: When Mem is summoned, immediately gains <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> Charge.
